signature.title: Email signature
signature.description: Used when a mailbox is set to each person's signature, or when that mailbox has no shared template. Placeholders such as {{name}}, {{first_name}}, {{last_name}} and {{company}} fill from your profile at send time.
signature.empty: Using the Bokito text default: closing, your name, role and contact details.
signature.editorContext: Your personal signature. Used when the mailbox source is “each person's signature”, or when the mailbox template is empty. Leave empty for the Bokito text default.

language.description: Choose the language for your interface.
language.deviceHint: This language stays on your account.
language.saveError: Language changed for this session, but could not be saved to your account.

landing.title: Start page
landing.description: Choose where Bokito opens after you sign in. Messages is the default.
landing.saveError: Could not save your start page.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Select a theme to personalize your dashboard's appearance.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password, connected accounts, and two-factor authentication.
security.passwordDescriptionSet: Set a password so you can sign in without Google or Microsoft, and unlink those accounts safely.
security.connectedDescription: Link Google or Microsoft to sign in faster. Unlink only when you still have a password or another provider.
security.unlinkBlocked: Set a password before unlinking your only sign-in method.
security.totpOnDescription: Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
security.totpOffDescription: Add an extra sign-in step with an authenticator app.
security.totpStep1: Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator, ...), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.totpDisableConfirm: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.

account.deletePasswordPrompt: Enter your password to confirm deletion:
